verdict.rationale: Buzz has a documented mechanism (buzz-acp harness) that listens for @mentions on the relay and has an agent reply via the Buzz CLI, with agents enrolled as first-class channel members via Nostr keypairs and add-member membership events; this is corroborated by the ACP harness docs, AGENTS.md ecosystem docs, and a live probe confirming the harness README. missing for 10: independent hands-on account of an agent actually responding to a mention in production, and more detail on multi-channel membership management UX beyond docs.
